title: How to Borrow Without Interest (Qard Hasan Explained) #qardhasan #islamicfinance
description:
You borrowed $30,000. Five years later you have paid $9,000 — and you owe $31,790. Nothing went wrong: interest bills $175 a month, your payment is $150, and the $25 gap is added back to the balance. You never borrowed a thing. You rented money. Qard hasan is the contract where a loan earns nothing, ever — borrow 30,000, repay 30,000 — and income-share puts the lender's return on what you actually earn, so the risk sits with the person who priced it.

Part 15 of The Money Machine, Decoded.
